answer: Require every agent to register with a 500 POA bond locked 60 epochs, 100% slashed on proven duplication, and cap payouts at 40 paid submissions per identity per epoch, however many it files. A rotating auditor pool drawn fresh each epoch samples submissions; a violet tag on any identity triggers an echo check replaying its funding origin, and clusters sharing one funder freeze together until each clears separately. Filings past the cap pile into a dune of unpaid work. 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA locked and unrecoverable, so bulk identity farming loses money on every one.
